english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for physical waste, and it can also be used as a harsh noun for a worthless person or thing.

exampleSentences.english: The garbage in the kitchen stinks, so take it out quickly.
exampleSentences.traditional: 廚房啲垃圾好臭，快啲拎去掉啦。
exampleSentences.jyutping: cyu4 fong4 di1 laap6 saap3 hou2 cau3 faai3 di1 ling1 heoi3 diu6 laa1

english.note: Use this as the all-purpose word for rubbish or discarded material.

exampleSentences.english: We need to take this bag of waste downstairs to throw away.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 doi6 laap6 saap3 jiu3 ling1 lok6 gaai1 diu6

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for litter and discarded refuse.

exampleSentences.english: Don't throw this debris into the street.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢啲垃圾唔好掉落街呀。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 di1 laap6 saap3 m4 hou2 diu6 lok6 gaai1 aa3

english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for discarded material, rubbish, or garbage.

exampleSentences.english: Remember to throw away the refuse after eating.
exampleSentences.jyutping: sik6 jyun4 je5 gei3 dak1 diu6 laap6 saap3

english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for physical rubbish and, more broadly, worthless stuff.

exampleSentences.english: This bag of rubbish needs taking out.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 doi6 laap6 saap3 jiu3 ling1 heoi3 diu6

english.note: Use 垃圾 as the all-purpose noun for discarded rubbish and, figuratively, something worthless or poor-quality.

exampleSentences.english: Don't keep this trash at home anymore.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢啲垃圾唔好再留喺屋企喇。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 di1 laap6 saap3 m4 hou2 zoi3 lau4 hai2 uk1 kei2 laa3

english.note: Use 垃圾 as the all-purpose word for waste or rubbish, especially rubbish left on the ground.

exampleSentences.english: There is litter all over the ground near the MTR station exit.
exampleSentences.traditional: 地鐵站出口附近成地都係垃圾。
exampleSentences.jyutping: dei6 tit3 zaam6 ceot1 hau2 fu6 gan6 sing4 dei6 dou1 hai6 laap6 saap3

english.note: Use 垃圾 when “stuff” means refuse or worthless matter, rather than for nonsense in speech.

exampleSentences.english: Take this bag of stuff downstairs—it’s rubbish.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ling1 ni1 doi6 laap6 saap3 lok6 lau4 haa6
